name: Narendra Modi Hands on Hips in Parliament
visual_description: Prime Minister Narendra Modi standing in the Lok Sabha with his hands placed firmly on his hips and a stern expression.
usage_context: Used to express disappointment, waiting for an explanation, defiance, or a confrontational 'now what?' reaction similar to the Pakistani cricket fan meme.
